rings.notes: All base-game checklist rings resolve against resources/rings.json after checklist/resource name normalization.

sorceries.notes: Sorcery scroll items are encoded in resources/goods_magic.json and surface through the save inventory goods bucket.

pyromancies.notes: Pyromancy items are encoded in resources/goods_magic.json and surface through the save inventory goods bucket.

miracles.notes: Miracle items are encoded in resources/goods_magic.json and surface through the save inventory goods bucket.

goods_key_items.notes: Most non-covenant/non-equipment area key items resolve through resources/goods_magic.json; weapon pickups and covenant memberships are separate categories.

game_key_items.notes: Base game_data key items overlap with area_checklists and can be checked when the item name exists in goods_magic.json.

area_weapons.notes: Some checklist key_items are weapon pickups such as Sellsword Twinblades and Butcher Knife; ownership is inventory-backed but grouped separately from goods.

reinforcement.notes: Weapon reinforcement checklist progress is currently reported as unsupported/static. The parser can expose per-weapon reinforcement fields from inventory entries, but completion progress is not save-backed end to end.

infusions.notes: Infusion is not a named inventory item in current static resources. It may be derivable from weapon item_id/entry fields, but should not be claimed from name resolution alone.

gestures.notes: Gestures are static checklist entries only. Local resources do not include gesture/event-flag offsets, so save-backed ownership must be reported as unsupported.
